newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African fundamentals "in perfect order" -Mandela.
newsitem.headline: S.African fundamentals "in perfect order" -Mandela.

text.p: South Africa's economic fundamentals are in good order, despite the volatility of the rand this year, President Nelson Mandela said on Tuesday.

"No one can dispute the basic reality that our fiscal and monetary fundamentals are in perfect order," he said in remarks prepared for delivery at a dinner of the South African Foreign Correspondents Association.

Reports on the South African economy often overlooked the positive investment that was already taking place, including several mega-projects of over 500,000 rand each which were changing the face of the country.
"In the past two years alone, over 18 billion rand in direct foreign investments have flowed into the country," he said.
